# fishyenergy

This uses functions from Troia and Perkin (2022) to predict gain of fish
mass using a model originally from Hanson et al. (1997).

Funded by [NSF
IOS-2222476](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=2222476)

See the [Getting Started
vignette](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/articles/Getting_Started.html)
for a quick introduction to the package and the [External Data
vignette](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/articles/External_Data.html)
for how to get data from the Fish Bioenergetics 4.0 software and USGS
water temperature data.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bem_curve()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/bem_curve.md)
  : Plot temperature dependent curves
- [`bem_grow()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/bem_grow.md)
  : Solve daily energy budgets to simulate growth over a calendar year
- [`bem_project()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/bem_project.md)
  : Project performance indices across heterogeneous habitat patches
- [`bem_validate()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/bem_validate.md)
  : Project growth to validate a bioenergetics model with empirical
  end-of-year mass
- [`consumption1()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/consumption1.md)
  : Consumption equation 1
- [`consumption2()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/consumption2.md)
  : Consumption equation 2
- [`consumption3()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/consumption3.md)
  : Consumption equation 3
- [`consumption4()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/consumption4.md)
  : Consumption equation 4
- [`envir_casc`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/envir_casc.md)
  : Environmental covariates for many stream reaches
- [`envir_lake`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/envir_lake.md)
  : Environmental covariates for many lakes
- [`parms_fb4`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/parms_fb4.md)
  : Intrinsic bioenergetics parameters from FB4
- [`parms_temporal_DEFAULT`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/parms_temporal_DEFAULT.md)
  : Temporally varying parameters
- [`respiration1()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/respiration1.md)
  : Respiration equation 1
- [`respiration2()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/respiration2.md)
  : Respiration equation 2
- [`respiration4()`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/respiration4.md)
  : Respiration equation 4
- [`temps_casc`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/temps_casc.md)
  : Daily water temperature for many streams
- [`temps_lake`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/temps_lake.md)
  : Daily water temperature for many lakes
- [`temps_nwis`](https://bomeara.github.io/fishyenergy/reference/temps_nwis.md)
  : Daily water temperature for one stream
